import csv
from collections import defaultdict
vals=list(csv.DictReader(open(VALUES_CSV)))
data=defaultdict(list)
for v in vals:
    data[v['timeseries_id']].append((v['timestamp'],float(v['value'])))

zones={
 'Z1_F3_Core_mid':'e0dd5f44-f050-5faa-a2a0-a3fcb6284ae8',
 'Z2_F3':'bcc5a78f-36a4-55a0-9420-7a80fc9b2deb',
 'Z3_F3':'9c6223f8-3611-5ceb-9107-70e8206e9ccd',
 'Z5_F3':'c49bbc2f-096e-5e16-bead-066250790308',
 'Z1_F2':'baef86cb-2941-5d61-87b0-ffa91d79f23a',
 'Z1_F4':'14a08406-79a0-52ca-b8a1-8563259dc820',
 'Z1_F1':'7a9e6dea-7214-57d7-a3ab-6fec741ab22a',
}
def monthly_mean(tsid):
    m=defaultdict(list)
    for t,v in data[tsid]:
        m[t[:7]].append(v)
    return {mo:sum(v)/len(v) for mo,v in m.items()}

for name,tsid in zones.items():
    mm=monthly_mean(tsid)
    pre=[mm[x] for x in mm if x<'2018-07']
    post=[mm[x] for x in mm if x>='2018-07']
    import statistics
    print(name, 'pre %.2f'%(sum(pre)/len(pre)), 'post %.2f'%(sum(post)/len(post)), 'delta %.2f'%(sum(post)/len(post)-sum(pre)/len(pre)))

content.text: Only temperature sensors and setpoints are exposed — no occupancy/power/CO2 streams that would indicate a true local load change, and no redundant independent temperature measurement in the zone that would falsify the sensor reading. The data cannot distinguish a local load change from a zone sensor fault.
